== English Reflections III comparison ==
The replacement imposes one exchange per weapon or battle destiny draw. The Dark image lacks that phrase in Decipher’s original. The exact D-E1 face retains the cancels-Opee, face-up card, exchange outcome and Alter immunity clauses. The Light card has a separate comparison.
